N02#1.zh: 俺是少华山头领『跳涧虎』陈达！今日要前往华阴县借粮，路经贵宝地，本着『四海之内皆兄弟』，欲借一条路。请史大郎答话！
N02#1.t: I am "Gorge-Leaping Tiger" Chen Da, chief of Mount Shaohua! Today we head for Huayin County to borrow grain, and your fine village lies in our path. "Within the four seas all men are brothers", so we ask leave to pass. Let young master Shi answer me!

N02#2.zh: 你们杀人放火，打家劫舍；犯下滔天大罪，全是些罪该万死的人！县内已经提出赏金捉拿你们，没想到你们居然敢来太岁头上动土！
N02#2.t: You murder, burn, rob and plunder. Your crimes reach the heavens, and every one of you deserves to die ten thousand times! The county has put a price on your heads, and now you dare to come and pull the tiger's whiskers!

N02#3.zh: 俺今日手下带有三四百名喽罗，如你不答应，俺只有以武力通过！喽罗皆是粗鲁人，奸淫掳掠在所难免！你再阻挡俺的去路，俺让你妻子不保！
N02#3.t: I've got three or four hundred lads with me today. If you won't agree, I'll just have to force my way through! My lads are rough men, and rape and plunder can't always be helped! Keep blocking my road and I won't answer for your women!

N02#4.zh: 此等人多说无益，必须好好教训他。王兄，那么你呢？
N02#4.t: There's no use talking to a man like this. He needs a proper lesson. Brother Wang, what about you?

N02#5.zh: 徒儿有难，师父怎可袖手旁观？
N02#5.t: How could a master stand by while his student is in trouble?

N02#6.zh: 陈达！就算我肯，还有一个不肯！
N02#6.t: Chen Da! Even if I agreed, there's one who won't!

N02#7.t: And who, good fellow, should I ask?

N02#8.zh: 你问得我手中这条棍棒肯时，便放你过去！
N02#8.t: Ask this staff in my hand. If it agrees, you may pass!

N02#9.zh: 欺人太甚！小子们，给我上！
N02#9.t: This is too much! Lads, get him!

N02#11.zh: 胜利条件一 --- 打败陈达

N02#12.zh: 胜利条件二 --- 所有喽罗死亡
N02#12.t: Victory 2 --- All the lackeys are killed

N02#14.zh: 失败条件二 --- 王进死亡

N02#15.zh: 失败条件三 --- 史进死亡

N02#16.t: With %N's help, Shi Jin finally drove off the bandits.

N02#17.zh: 王进死后，史进发狂，连毙敌人数十名，终力尽而死，庄客们一轰而散。
N02#17.t: After Wang Jin died, Shi Jin went berserk and killed dozens of the enemy before he fell from exhaustion. The farmhands scattered.

N02#18.zh: 史进死后，%N发狂，连毙敌人数十名，终力尽而死，庄客们一轰而散。
N02#18.t: After Shi Jin died, %N went berserk and killed dozens of the enemy before he fell from exhaustion. The farmhands scattered.

N02#19.zh: 哼！没想到史进那么顽强，喽罗！你领几个人回少华山禀报大头目，把所有人都给俺带过来！
N02#19.t: Hmph! Who knew Shi Jin would put up such a fight? You there! Take a few men back to Mount Shaohua and tell the chief. Have him bring everyone here!

N02#22.zh: 糟了！不能让那几个人逃走！
N02#22.t: Oh no! We can't let those men get away!

N02#24.zh: 若让少华山众匪倾巢而出的话，就麻烦了！
N02#24.t: If the whole Mount Shaohua gang comes down on us, we're in real trouble!

N02#26.zh: 庄后有条通往少华山必经之地的捷径，我派几名家丁前去拦截！
N02#26.t: Behind the manor there's a shortcut they must take back to Mount Shaohua. I'll send some servants to cut them off!

N02#27.zh: 唔...我看还是慎重一些的好，不如就请王兄领几名庄客前往吧！
N02#27.t: Hmm... I think we should be careful. Brother Wang, would you take a few farmhands and go?

N02#31.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败陈达

N02#33.t: With %N's help, Shi Jin finally drove off the bandits.

N02#34.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！
N02#34.t: The turn limit has run out with the mission unfinished. Game over!

N02#35.zh: %N死后，史进发狂，连毙敌人数十名，终力尽而死，庄客们一轰而散，王进带着老母继续亡命天涯，从此不知去向........
N02#35.t: After %N died, Shi Jin went berserk and killed dozens of the enemy before he fell from exhaustion. The farmhands scattered. Wang Jin fled on with his old mother, and was never heard of again........
